summary: Master the art of tour operations with our comprehensive training course. Gain practical knowledge and skills to thrive in the dynamic travel sector.
lede: Tour operations management centers on planning, pricing, contracting, and distributing travel products. Designed for travel agency, tour operations, and product development professionals, the course covers itinerary and dynamic-package design, yield calculations, supplier negotiations, channel integration, financial reconciliation, and destination risk planning.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who design, manage, and distribute travel products in a competitive global market.
modules: Travel Distribution Ecosystem and NDC Integration
Yield Management and Travel Pricing Strategies
Tour Product Development and Dynamic Packaging
Travel Technology, AI, and CRM Operations
Travel Risk Management and Crisis Response
Strategic Agency Growth and Performance Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic travel agency operations, tour coordination, or corporate travel management. No advanced technical expertise in API integration or financial modeling is required, but familiarity with industry terminology (e.g., GDS, net rates) is highly recommended.
